product_one_liner.value: Sona provides an AI-native workforce management platform—including scheduling, HR, payroll and communications—for frontline organisations.
product_one_liner.notes: Sona describes itself as an AI-native frontline workforce-management platform and says it covers scheduling, HR, payroll and communications for frontline organisations.

pricing_page.notes: Sona has a public pricing page describing configurable pricing and inviting visitors to book a consultation; the page also offers a custom quote. A public pricing page exists even though it does not list fixed prices.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Sona's About page names Hawksmoor, Popeyes, Paul Bakeries and Voyage Care as organisations it helps. | named_customers.0: Sona's About page names Hawksmoor among the organisations it helps. | named_customers.1: Sona's About page names Popeyes among the organisations it helps. | named_customers.2: Sona's About page names Paul Bakeries among the organisations it helps. | named_customers.3: Sona's About page names Voyage Care among the organisations it helps.

employee_band.notes: The company profile lists Sona in the 101–200 employee band.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The headquarters address identifies London as the city. | hq_country: The company profile gives Sona's headquarters address in London, United Kingdom.

founded_year.notes: Sona's About page says it was founded in 2021.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index presents workforce-management insights, partnerships, product news and other editorial content; it does not show at least two engineering-authored posts about how Sona's product is built. The architecture-titled post is authored by Saffana Monajed and describes general product/market strategy rather than Sona engineering implementation.

public_docs.notes: Sona has a public support center with multiple product-help articles, including questions about downloading the app and messaging a manager.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live Senior Machine Learning Engineer posting describes joining Sona's ML team, supporting a positive answer.

model_provider.notes: Sona's sub-processor list identifies OpenAI and Anthropic as LLM providers.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: Sona's Trust Center names ISO 27001:2022 and GDPR. Only the requested certification names supported by that page are included. | compliance_certs.0: The Trust Center explicitly names ISO 27001:2022. | compliance_certs.1: The Trust Center explicitly names GDPR.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The latest funding announcement identifies the round as a Series B. | funding_date: The Series B announcement is dated April 1, 2026, so the requested YYYY-MM value is 2026-04. | funding_amount_usd: Sona's funding announcement identifies its Series B as $45 million, equivalent to USD 45,000,000.

raised_18mo.notes: The Series B was announced on April 1, 2026, within the 18 months before November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Sona has an Account Executive job posting, which meets the specified qualifying sales titles.

launched_6mo.notes: Sona published “Why we launched Sona LMS” on June 22, 2026, describing an LMS connected to workforce operations. This launch falls within the six months before November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: On February 9, 2026, Sona announced Richard Tallboy's appointment as Chief Information Officer Advisor, describing it as a newly created executive advisory role. This is within the 12-month window. The announcement describes an advisor role, not an appointment as Sona's CIO.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: A Sona GTM role names HubSpot in its data-model responsibilities; Sona's sub-processor list identifies Planhat as its CRM and Mandrill (Mailchimp) as an email tool. | crm_stack_signal.0: The Sona GTM role explicitly names HubSpot. | crm_stack_signal.1: Sona's sub-processor list identifies Planhat as its CRM. | crm_stack_signal.2: Sona's sub-processor list identifies Mandrill (Mailchimp) as an email tool.
